redFlags.note: Conflict: the Wikipedia list gives lap 27 (citing formula1.com, not read). Jolpica: leader's lap 26 took 160s (slower than the SC lap 25 at 120s) and lap 27 holds the stoppage (1683s); 26 taken from GrandPrix.com. If the build's timing puts the red status on lap 27, the build will refuse this entry: check against the timing. The standing restart (lap 28) was the first in F1 under the 2018 rule.
